notes: Manufacturer spec page (ptzoptics.com/move-4k/) is the authoritative source and was used for all port data; corroborated by web search results referencing AV retailer listings (B&H, Sweetwater, Full Compass) for the same SDI/HDMI/USB/IP port set, though those retailer pages returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch. Camera family ships in multiple zoom variants (12x/20x/30x) and colors (white/gray) with identical I/O. HDMI and SDI outputs are mutually exclusive (cannot drive both simultaneously) - noted on the HDMI port. The RS-232 ports use an 8-pin mini-DIN connector, which has no exact match in the allowed connector list; mapped to "midi-din" as the closest analog (also used for MIDI's 5-pin DIN) - flagged as an inferred/approximate connector type. The RS-485 port uses a 2-pin Phoenix/captive screw terminal block, mapped to "euroblock" as the closest listed connector. Power can be supplied either via the 12V DC barrel jack or via PoE+ over Ethernet; both are valid power inputs but only the DC barrel jack is listed as a discrete port since PoE shares the RJ45 port already listed. No rack-mount form factor (desktop/ceiling/tripod PTZ camera), so rackUnits omitted.

ports.name: HDMI
ports.note: Up to 4K@60fps; HDMI and SDI cannot output simultaneously

ports.name: USB
ports.note: USB 2.0 Type-A video output, up to 4K@30fps (UVC)

ports.name: IP / Ethernet
ports.note: 10/100/1000M adaptive; carries NDI|HX, SRT, RTSP, RTMP streaming and PoE+ power

ports.name: Audio In
ports.note: 3.5mm line-level audio input, embeddable into SDI/HDMI/USB/NDI

ports.name: RS-232 In
ports.note: 8-pin mini-DIN; VISCA/Pelco-D/Pelco-P camera control, closest listed connector to the 8-pin mini-DIN used

ports.name: RS-232 Out
ports.note: 8-pin mini-DIN; VISCA/Pelco-D/Pelco-P camera control pass-through, closest listed connector to the 8-pin mini-DIN used

ports.name: RS-485
ports.note: 2-pin Phoenix/terminal block; VISCA/Pelco-D/Pelco-P daisy-chain control, max 1200m

ports.name: DC IN 12V
ports.note: JEITA-type DC barrel jack, 12V, max 18W draw; alternatively powered via PoE+ (802.3at) over the RJ45 port
